# PayScale

> > PayScale provides comprehensive compensation data, salary surveys, and pay analytics software to help organizations and individuals make informed compensation decisions.

PayScale offers a suite of compensation management solutions including Payfactors, Marketpay, and Payscale Academy, delivering real-time salary data and workforce analytics. The platform serves HR professionals, employers, and job seekers with tools for salary comparison, pay equity analysis, and compensation intelligence.

## Key Topics

- Compensation Management
- Salary Data & Surveys
- Pay Analytics
- Payfactors
- Marketpay
- HR Software
- Compensation Intelligence
- Workforce Management
- Pay Equity
- Payscale Academy
- Payscale Connect
- Salary Benchmarking
- Total Rewards
- Compensation Planning
